{{Top}}
[[File:2-1B-AoRCR.png|thumb|200px|A 2-1B surgical droid]]
{{Quote|Useless machine! Useless! Useless!|Darth Vader, in a fit of anger, attacking a 2-1B medical droid|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Medical droids''', '''medi-droids''', '''meddroids''', '''Emdee droids''', '''diagnostic droids''', or '''surgeon droids'''<ref name="LF">{{JournalCite|11|The Longest Fall}}</ref> were specialized in medical and surgical operations. A classification of [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]], medical droids were actually considered to be members of the larger [[biological science droid]] classification, but were typically listed separately due to their prominence.

==Overview==
[[File:MedicalDroid-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Medical droids were commonly used as far back as the days of the Old Republic]]
[[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]] was full of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and it could be very hard for a flesh-and-[[Blood/Legends|blood]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] to know how to effectively treat more than a few of them. Medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had no such shortcomings, some even had a passable [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedside]] manner.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Medical Droid">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Medical Droid}}</ref> The most popular meddroids included the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] and [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series]] medics. [[GH-7 medical analysis unit]]s were common throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] employed [[DD-13 medical assistant droid/Legends|DD-13 medical assistant droids]] for their dark reconstruction surgery.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> There were even models that [[Vet droid|specialized in non-sentient creatures]].

==History==
[[File:Chopper.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The DD-13 medical assistant droid specialized in installing cybernetics.]]
The Geeaych-Seven was also known as the GH-7 meddroid. Its data banks were filled with information about almost all medical problems, physical or mental. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a GH-7 was deployed at the [[Polis Massa Research Base]] to oversee the medical treatment of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with the assistance of a [[Midwife droid/Legends|Midwife droid]] as she gave birth to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

A team of DD-13 cybernetic surgical droids were used to reconstruct [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] after he was severely injured in a duel with his former master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was treated in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|Bacta tank]] operated by two medical droids, a [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] and an [[FX-7/Legends|FX-7]], in the [[Echo Base medical center/Legends|Echo Base medical lab]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The same droids would replace Skywalker's hand with a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] replacement after losing it to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>

Another medical droid pulled shrapnel out of Luke after his escape from the [[Cavrilhu Pirates|Cavrilhu Pirate]] Base.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
